prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Generate a substantially improved hitoami mobile hero photograph, portrait 2:3, maximum quality. References: r1/m2.png is the previous rejected composition, NOT a quality target. site_wide.png and room_mobile.png establish a real intimate Japanese yarn craft room. logo.png gives ONLY terracotta #AB5631 color, never reproduce logo. s2_雪宝段染.jpg is exact yarn product identity; s2_雪宝段染_色卡.jpg bottom-right swatch is exact knitted fiber and color reference.
Photograph a lived-in room rather than a product against a studio wall. Old honey oak worktable in foreground, a visible narrow passage of worn timber floor and jute rug behind its LEFT edge, a low oak yarn cubby in the distant lower RIGHT, room corner and soft spatial recession below the text area. At far left a narrow edge of natural linen curtain may appear ONLY below y=50%. Layered soft daylight enters from the left, softly shadowed recesses at right, realistic contact shadows and modest sunlight falling on floor and table below y=58%. Neutral product color, no orange grade. A restrained unglazed terracotta cup and casually folded faded terracotta linen on the rear right tabletop; a tiny butter-yellow linen accent. No plants, no decorative baskets, no vase. Premium lifestyle editorial photograph, 50mm lens f/4, physical materials, subtle lens depth, no artificial haze. Delicate wall variation, not noisy stucco.
HARD LAYOUT: top 14% quiet cream plaster. Rectangle x=8–85%, y=18–49% completely clean cream plaster #F9F6F0 with low contrast texture, no objects, edges or strong shadows. ALL yarn, scarf, cup, cubby and other subjects entirely at y>=58%; highest object begins y=60%. Keep wall calm across upper half but create palpable room depth in lower half. Furniture background and floor occupy narrow band around y=59–73%, tabletop and foreground project y=68–99%. Do not sacrifice this safety zone to enlarge subjects.
Main subject: half-knitted fringed scarf, exact green/yellow/cream Xuebao space-dyed yarn, with airy fine long matte hairs like real product reference. Moss green, leafy yellow-green, deep muted eucalyptus green, creamy ivory and warm golden yellow in irregular broad transverse dyed sections, not regular rainbow stripes, no added terracotta in yarn. Fine credible stockinette V stitches partly softened by substantial attached fiber fuzz, lightweight drape, not thick smooth wool. Scarf upper live edge around x=19–56%, y=73%, runs toward lower left foreground with a natural fold, completed lower end at y=94% with five or six modest tied fringes ending before y=99%. ONE straight wooden knitting needle passes through all individual live stitches, with its point visible. One continuous working strand exits last live stitch on right and curves naturally onto table to working ball at x=73%, y=83%. ONE spare wooden needle rests diagonally on table beside scarf. No extra needle or stray branching strand.
Exactly THREE balls of this same reference product: one partly used working ball at x=75%, y=83%, and two additional balls offset behind it at x=72%, y=66% and x=88%, y=73%, all wholly beneath y=58%. Preserve softly elongated OVAL commercially wound balls, loose crisscross wraps with generous delicate long fiber hairs, no perfect spheres, no cakes, no hanks. Natural different orientations and visible portions of same dye sequence, cream and gold on one, leafy green and eucalyptus on another. No cloned balls. The low background cubby may contain folded cream textiles and a few indistinct blank navy books but NO additional yarn balls, so exact yarn quantity remains readable. A small closed blank navy cloth book can support one spare ball. Tiny scuffs, a faint old cup ring and asymmetrical linen fold suggest real use without clutter. Clear physically supported objects, natural continuous yarn.
No text, numbers, labels, bands, tags, paper packaging, QR, logo, watermark, UI, people or animals. No glowing fuzz, bokeh dots, halos, floating objects, plastic textures, repetitive artificial grain. Compose new photograph with greater room depth, refined natural light and visible terracotta accents than rejected image while faithfully retaining product and strict text safety zone.

FINAL COMPOSITION CORRECTION, overriding prior coordinates and reference framing: Step back substantially. The previous result placed top ball at 45% and shelf at 30%, which FAILS. Compress the entire room vignette into the BOTTOM 40% of the portrait. Topmost ball at y=62%, shelf top at y=59%, cup top at y=63%, scarf live needle at y=77%, scarf fringe ends y=97%. All props and furniture start below y=58%. Entire upper 58% must be softly lit cream wall, no curtain visible there. Curtain edge starts y=59%, floor strip at y=65%, table rear edge y=70%. Preserve depth by showing a small floor passage on left between table and wall, with sunlight ONLY on this lower floor. Reduce scarf and balls in image size to 70% of previous result. The same tactile product, room depth, terracotta cup and linen should appear in a smaller lower composition. Do not enlarge the still life to fill the image. Upper wall is deliberately reserved for website copy.
